metadata.description: Own skills, hooks and rules from the agentic-setup packs. Upstream items install through npx agentic-setup.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Makes "done" mean the agreed checks pass. Adds an acceptance-checks rule, a Stop-hook gate, a blind plan review and a skeptic pass over review findings.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: A rule for grading generic, template-looking UI by severity instead of by counting tricks.

plugins.name: core-extras
plugins.description: Small additions to core skills. Grilling sessions turn each settled decision into a check you can test.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Scans a third-party skill before you install it. Needs NVIDIA SkillSpector.
